messages:
Aisha: AM standup — quick update. Yesterday: landed kernel hotpatch that changes microbatch packing (PR #4821). Local sim benches show ~+6% throughput and p95 down ~8ms. Blocker: seeing KV cache eviction spike on shard-7 during long-tail requests, which causes small p99 blips. Today: triage eviction, add finer-grained logging, and request reviews on the PR: https://git.local/r/redwood/infra/pull/4821. Anyone able to run a dedicated canary later?

Matt: saw the Sentry alerts earlier. Is this the eviction policy change from last week? @Aisha can you paste the eviction logs/stack traces here? I can run the canary around 10:30 PT. Ping @Sylvie to reserve a canary window.

Jiang: quick thought — we did lower eviction thresholds for bursty workloads; might be interacting badly with prefetch. Try bumping hot cache ratio to 0.15 and re-run a short smoke. Example flag: `hot_cache_ratio=0.15`.

Leo: I pushed a tiny alignment patch that also affects batching (PR #4829). Ran a bench on rtx-server-3: throughput +4%, p99 unchanged. Happy to help run the canary and combine results.

Sylvie: I can open a 30m canary window at 10:30 PT on dedicated-staging-1. ops-bot, can you schedule that? :calendar:

ops-bot: Canary scheduled at 10:30 PT on pool `dedicated-staging-1`. I will post updates when the job runs.

Aisha: thanks — attaching a short log snippet from the repro run: ```
evict_rate=0.23 shard=7 p99_lat_ms=342
prefetch_hits=0.12
``` Also, running local tests with `--batch-size 48` lowered the burstiness; will add that to the logging PR and tag reviewers.

Matt: LGTM on the logging changes once CI is green. Question: do we need to toggle `kernel_prefetch` during rollout? If so, include a clear rollback step in the change description.

Jiang: suggested rollout plan: canary -> observe 15m p95/p99 -> if stable, promote to 10% traffic for 30m -> 50% -> full. I'll draft a tiny runbook and post it here.

Leo: if canary fails, rollback plan is: flip to commit `abc1234`, purge local KV caches on affected nodes, and revert the microbatch packing flag. I'll prepare a rollback script and keep it ready.

Sylvie: noted. I'll watch dashboards and assign oncall to the canary window. :eyes:

ops-bot: Canary started. Collecting metrics (p50/p95/p99, evict_rate, CPU/GPU).

ops-bot: Canary completed: initial 15m metrics look OK. Promoted to 10% traffic. Minor increase in evict debug counters but p99 and throughput stable.

Aisha: awesome — thanks all. I'll follow up with a short write-up and schedule the 10->50% rollout for tomorrow if no regressions. Tagging reviewers again and will merge after another quick perf run. :thumbsup:
